title.narrative: Rallying Efforts to Accelerate Progress (REAP) - Africa Inequalities Initiative

description.narrative: REAP aims to holistically address economic inequalities in Africa through tackling illicit financial flows, tax evasion and tax avoidance, while recognising the centrality of power relations and imbalances at the intersection of income and wealth disparities, gender and social status. At the national level, with a focus on tax incentives in Kenya and land governance in South Africa, the project seeks to strengthen social accountability over policies and decisions fuelling and sustaining income and wealth inequalities and to promote greater access to public resources by vulnerable and marginalised groups. REAP will also promote greater regional and global action to disrupt the mechanisms enabling illicit financial flows, tax evasion and tax avoidance and undermining the sustainable development of countries in Africa. Value of the contract EUR 3,666,666.

recipient-region.narrative: The following countries are recipients: Ethiopia, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Mauritius, Morocco, Nigeria, Republic of Congo (RC), South Africa, and Zambia.
